## Design

### 2026-10-18 – I worked on some of the initial ideas and decided what would be reasonable to do in my time frame. First I talked about what it actually was, then I listed out my goals for the project, what objects i

**2h**

I worked on some of the initial ideas and decided what would be reasonable to do in my time frame. First I talked about what it actually was, then I listed out my goals for the project, what objects it could count, some of the items I would need, expected problems and stuff I would include in V1 vs V2 if I make a V2.

Then i designed and  reviewed it and changed the bracket for mounting the pieces together, i changed it from cylindrical mount shape to a squarish one to allow for the screws to have more space, i also changed the angle a bit on the inside of the zig zag one so that it would slow the parts down even more to allow the ir sensor to work better
